title: Microsoft Ignite 101: Navigate, Connect & Maximize Your Experience
description: Join Rick Claus and Sonia Cuff for a fun, fast-paced guide to getting the most out of your time at Microsoft Ignite. Learn how the conference is laid out, how to plan your day, and where to find answers from the experts – be they MVPs, Microsoft Partners or the Product teams. Get the inside scoop on all the event experiences. From Breakouts to the "hallway track", this session will help you build your network and make the most of your Ignite experience.

title: Real-World AI Transformation with Copilot in SharePoint​‌
speakerNames: Rk Menon, Matt Wolodarsky, Amy Curley, PhD
description: Organizations are moving beyond AI experiments and into production. See how customers are using Copilot in SharePoint to modernize knowledge management, organize content at scale, automate business processes, preserve expertise, and strengthen Copilot experiences. Through real-world examples and customer stories, learn practical approaches for turning scattered content into organizational knowledge and transforming knowledge into action across the enterprise.

title: Trust at scale: Governance lessons from Microsoft
description: As Microsoft deploys AI across products used by hundreds of millions of people, trust has become an operational imperative. In this session, Sarah Bird, Microsoft's Chief Product Officer for Responsible AI, shares how Microsoft approaches AI governance, safety, security, and compliance across its own AI systems. Learn practical lessons in risk-based governance, embedded guardrails, continuous monitoring, and scalable controls that enable trusted AI at scale.

title: Operate AI at enterprise scale with Microsoft Foundry

location.displayValue: Marriott Marquis | Lower B2, Yerba Buena Salon 8
location.logicalValue: Marriott Marquis | Lower B2, Yerba Buena Salon 8

speakerNames: Mayunk Jain, Rong Lu, Mehrnoosh Sameki
description: AI adoption is expanding to fleets of agents, making governance an operational challenge. Explore how AI Gateway, Responsible AI controls, agent identity, FinOps, and governance integrations provide visibility and control across your AI estate. Microsoft Foundry provides the governance foundation for AI systems, integrating with Agent 365 for enterprise operations and administration. Leave with a practical framework for running AI securely from development to production.

title: Winning the Race Against Time with Autonomous Protection
speakerNames: Noam Hadash, Raviv Tamir, Ken Robb
description: AI is changing the economics of cyberattacks, compressing the gap between discovery and exploitation. Learn how Microsoft is rethinking autonomous protection for an era where exposure evolves faster than traditional defenses can keep pace.

title: What the Frontlines Reveal About Modern Security
description: What threats and challenges are Microsoft experts seeing on the frontlines of cyber defense? Hear directly from frontline experts and explore practical guidance for making threat intelligence actionable, operationalizing AI agents, and building cyber resilience.

title: Project Perception: How Agentic Security Works

location.displayValue: Marriott Marquis | Lower B2, Yerba Buena Salon 9
location.logicalValue: Marriott Marquis | Lower B2, Yerba Buena Salon 9

description: Stay ahead of evolving threats with Project Perception, Microsoft’s new agentic security system. See how specialized red, blue, and green team agents work together with shared security context to expose weaknesses, investigate threats, prioritize risk, and strengthen defenses. Learn how coordinated multi-agent defense helps your team move from reactive security to continuous protection, while keeping people in control of critical decisions.

title: Find and fix code vulnerabilities faster with Codename MDASH

location.displayValue: Marriott Marquis | Lower B2, Yerba Buena Salon 8
location.logicalValue: Marriott Marquis | Lower B2, Yerba Buena Salon 8

description: Accelerate vulnerability discovery with multi-model agentic security. Codename MDASH orchestrates specialized AI agents and security-focused AI models to identify, validate, and prioritize vulnerabilities, helping teams understand risk and focus on the issues that matter most.

title: Agentic Security Unfiltered with Allie Mellen: Hype vs. Reality

location.displayValue: Marriott Marquis | Lower B2, Yerba Buena Salon 9
location.logicalValue: Marriott Marquis | Lower B2, Yerba Buena Salon 9

speakerNames: Tanmay Ganacharya, Kim Kischel, Raviv Tamir, Allie Mellen
description: Explore the real-time architectural breakdown of what happens when agentic AI hits production IT environments. Together, Forrester principal analyst Allie Mellen and two Microsoft executives will tear down a modern SOC architecture live on stage—mapping out where agents safely automate outcomes, where non-deterministic AI breaks IT change controls, and how to design guardrails that CISOs and IT Directors can actually trust.

title: Project Perception Roadmap: New Capabilities, Use Cases & What's Next
speakerNames: Hari Pulapaka, David Miller, Will Pocknell
description: How must security operations evolve when AI can act? Explore Microsoft’s agentic security vision and roadmap and learn how people, AI agents, and trusted controls can work together to accelerate defense across the security lifecycle.

title: Inside Look at Agent 365: Lessons from Microsoft's Office of the CISO
description: As organizations deploy more AI agents, security teams face new visibility, risk, and governance challenges. Join us to hear best practices and lessons learned from Microsoft's Office of the CISO on how to use Agent 365 for a growing agentic estate. Drawing on Microsoft’s experience, you’ll gain actionable guidance to strengthen AI security and governance while accelerating innovation responsibly.

title: Build the managed intelligence stack for SMBs with Pax8 and Microsoft
description: SMBs are eager to adopt AI, but many lack the security, governance, and expertise to do it safely. See how partners can turn Microsoft's SMB offers into a managed intelligence stack, helping customers adopt AI more securely while building profitable services. Leaders at Pax8 will show how to leverage SMB-focused security bundles, partner-led service opportunities, and scalable partner programs to create a repeatable AI adoption motion for SMB customers.

title: Expanding what’s possible: How AI is redesigning work
description:
AI is changing how people work and how organizations build new business capabilities. Join Jacob Andreou, Executive Vice President, Copilot, to explore how Copilot brings asking, delegating, building, and scaling together, and how Windows extends that experience across the PC. Learn how Teams connects people, agents, and business processes across functions, and how new FinOps capabilities help organizations manage and scale Copilot with confidence. See what becomes possible when AI is built into the flow of work, from the individual to the organization.

Seating is limited and available on a first-come, first-served basis. We encourage you to arrive early to secure a seat before the session begins.

title: Microsoft Ignite opening keynote
description: Satya Nadella and Judson Althoff unveil the latest innovations driving the next wave of AI transformation.

title: Partner Keynote: Ignite Frontier Transformation
speakerNames: Nicole Dezen, Mala Anand, Stephen Boyle, Ralph Haupter
description: Nicole Dezen and Judson Althoff join Microsoft leaders and partners to explore how trust and customer value build the next great markets.

title: Delegate complex work: Hands-on with Copilot Cowork
description:
Agent usage is up 15× year over year, and more multi-step workflows can now be delegated end to end. In this hands-on session, build a real workflow with Copilot Cowork: turn a complex process into a skill, extend it with plugins and automations, and see how Cowork plans, executes, and delivers work across systems and apps. Leave with a publishable skill and a practical model for deciding what to delegate, how to scope it, and how to move work from intent to done.

title: Build, observe, and scale AI-ready apps and workloads with AKS
description:
Deploy and operate AI inference on AKS without building a cluster from scratch. Deploy a prepared AI application to AKS Automatic, request GPU resources, and watch Automatic provision the required compute. You then run inference, inspect application and GPU metrics, generate load, and observe scaling. A final Ray exercise demonstrates distributed AI on the same AKS foundation. The lab follows an AI workload from container image to a secure, observable, scalable deployment.

title: Improve token efficiency with vLLM Semantic Router
description: In this lab, you'll build a single endpoint for multiple models on AMD Instinct™ GPUs and use vLLM Semantic Router to match each request to the right model. Route simple tasks to smaller models and complex work to larger ones to save tokens and compute, while keeping sensitive requests on trusted local models. Connect an agent, explore routing decisions, and put your skills to the test by building your own router in a short challenge.

title: Welcome to Live at Microsoft Ignite​

location.displayValue: Moscone South | The Hub, Ignite Broadcast Stage
location.logicalValue: Moscone South | The Hub, Ignite Broadcast Stage

description: Live technical demoes, customer conversations, panel discussions, Executive insights, and dynamic interviews – live from the floor at Microsoft Ignite.​

title: The browser for every agent: Remote MCP Playwright Cloud Browser

location.displayValue: Moscone South | The Hub, Lightning Talk 5
location.logicalValue: Moscone South | The Hub, Lightning Talk 5

description: Browser automation is becoming a core capability for agentic applications. This session explores how Remote MCP exposes Playwright Cloud Browser as a shared browser service across Copilot, Foundry, GitHub Copilot, and custom agents. Learn how it enables reliable web navigation, data extraction, and task execution, with built-in observability to simplify debugging. We’ll also demonstrate secure access to public websites and private VNet applications for enterprise-ready browser automation.

title: Operationalize MCP with enterprise governance controls

location.displayValue: Moscone South | The Hub, Lightning Talk 7
location.logicalValue: Moscone South | The Hub, Lightning Talk 7

description: As agents connect to more MCP servers and enterprise tools, organizations need visibility into what can be accessed and how those interactions are used. Learn how to publish enterprise MCP servers, secure access to enterprise tools, apply runtime policies, and monitor agent interactions through a centralized gateway. Gain practical approaches for bringing MCP into enterprise environments with the visibility and controls required for production deployment.

title: MCP Runs Both Ways: Governing Power Automate in the Agent Era

location.displayValue: Moscone South | The Hub, Lightning Talk 7
location.logicalValue: Moscone South | The Hub, Lightning Talk 7

description:
Two very different capabilities are both being called "Power Automate MCP," and the difference decides your governance model.
You'll leave with a publish-gate checklist, an environment pattern for agent-facing flows, and a clear answer to "which of our flows are exposed as tools, and running as whom?"

title: MCP Runs Both Ways: Governing Power Automate in the Agent Era

location.displayValue: Moscone South | The Hub, Lightning Talk 1
location.logicalValue: Moscone South | The Hub, Lightning Talk 1

description:
Two very different capabilities are both being called "Power Automate MCP," and the difference decides your governance model.
You'll leave with a publish-gate checklist, an environment pattern for agent-facing flows, and a clear answer to "which of our flows are exposed as tools, and running as whom?"

title: Agent 365: Governing agent access to Microsoft 365 content
description: An agent without your content isn't very useful. An agent with the wrong access is a risk. See how Agent 365 helps you govern how agents use your Microsoft 365 content. In demos, use the agent access heatmap to see which content agents use, how sensitive it is, and whether they read or change it. Then set content guardrails once, on agent blueprints, so they apply to every agent, today's and tomorrow's, and bring in the content owners best placed to decide.

title: Host, secure and manage your code faster with Copilot Managed Runtime
speakerNames: David Blyth, Joe Unwin, Clay Wesener
description: Code has never been more accessible, but getting it ready to run securely in the enterprise still takes work. Learn how Copilot Managed Runtime provides a host for code built with Code, Cowork, and Copilot Studio, with hosting, vulnerability scanning, identity, connectors, governance, and lifecycle management built in. See how developers and partners can also use the Copilot Managed Runtime SDK to bring the same managed runtime to apps built with third-party development tools such as Lovable.

title: Understand how attackers use AI to create and evade malware
description: AI is changing how attackers create, evade detection, and deliver malware, while giving defenders new ways to identify threats. See demonstrations of AI-assisted malware creation, exploit detection, and delivery methods, and learn how to distinguish human-driven techniques from those enabled by AI.

title: One endpoint, every tool: MCP, A2A, and skills in Microsoft Foundry

location.displayValue: Moscone South | The Hub, Theater E
location.logicalValue: Moscone South | The Hub, Theater E

description: You don't have a tool problem. You have an integration problem — every agent team wiring the same MCP servers, APIs, and credentials over again. See how Toolboxes in Foundry unifies MCP servers, OpenAPI services, A2A agents, built-in tools, and skills behind a single MCP contract any framework can call. Change tools without touching agent code, send the model 3 relevant tools instead of 127, and govern identity, policy, and audit in one place.

title: Hardening MCP: Advanced Security and Scale for Enterprise AI Hubs

location.displayValue: Moscone South | The Hub, Theater H
location.logicalValue: Moscone South | The Hub, Theater H

description: Exposing Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers to enterprise production introduces massive scalability and security hurdles. In this advanced, demo-first session, we address the architectural realities of deploying the new stateless MCP standard. Drawing from real-world FastTrack deployments, we will dissect advanced multi-tenant routing, stateless load balancing, and prompt-injection mitigation. Learn how to securely scale AI data pipelines without compromising corporate data boundaries.

title: Identity first: Build business resiliency across Azure and M365

location.displayValue: Moscone South | The Hub, Partner Theater
location.logicalValue: Moscone South | The Hub, Partner Theater

description: Rackspace and Rubrik explore business resiliency beyond backup, starting with identity. See how to sequence recovery across Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory, Microsoft 365 data, and Azure infrastructure. Learn about immutable backups, rapid restoration, air-gapped protection, and the importance of a tested recovery runbook. Leave with a practical model for restoring identity, access, data, and infrastructure in the right order.

title: Beyond RAG: Agentic retrieval with the Cosmos DB MCP Toolkit

location.displayValue: Moscone South | Upper Mezzanine, Esplanade Ballroom, Table 12
location.logicalValue: Moscone South | Upper Mezzanine, Esplanade Ballroom, Table 12

description:
Single-shot RAG breaks on hard questions: grab a few chunks, answer confidently anyway. In this 25-minute hands-on session, go deep on agentic retrieval on Azure Cosmos DB. The Cosmos DB MCP Toolkit makes retrieval a first-class agent tool — iterative, multi-hop RAG that detects gaps, issues follow-up sub-queries, and synthesizes a grounded answer. Then wire an agent to hosted MCP (preview), secured with Entra ID, to reach live Cosmos data with nothing to deploy. We build it live, hop by hop.

Seating for this session is first-come, first-served. Add it to your schedule to plan your day and arrive early to secure a spot.

title: MCP Runs Both Ways | Governing Power Automate in the Agent Era

location.displayValue: Moscone South | Upper Mezzanine, Esplanade Ballroom, Table 5
location.logicalValue: Moscone South | Upper Mezzanine, Esplanade Ballroom, Table 5

description:
Join a small-group technical discussion for Power Platform architects, CoE leads, and platform owners on the two directions called Power Automate MCP | flows exposed as tools an agent calls, and agents that author or debug flows. Compare how each changes risk, which surfaces are first-party or community, what is GA or preview, and what publish gates, environment patterns, and run-as governance are needed.
